title: Harissa tofu tray bake
summary: Harissa tofu tray bake is a middle eastern dinner built around firm tofu and red peppers, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Harissa tofu tray bake into even pieces and toss red peppers with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of red peppers while you season firm tofu. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle firm tofu and red onions among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Harissa tofu tray bake before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Harissa tofu tray bake into warm bowls with the juices.
